panels.description: T1041 대용량 응답 = NGINX 로그에서 5MB를 넘는 정상(200) 응답 수. T1041 송신량 급증 = 웹 ASG의 송신 데이터(NetworkOut) 5분 합계가 50MB 이상인 5분 구간 수. 임계값은 평소 트래픽에 맞게 수식의 숫자를 조정하세요.

targets.expression:
fields if((path = "/rest/user/login" and status = 401), "T1110", if((request_uri like "169.254.169.254" or request_uri like "latest/meta-data" or request_uri like "computeMetadata"), "T1552_005", if((request_uri like /(?i)(union.{1,3}select|or.{1,3}1=1|%27|%2527|<script|%3cscript|javascript:|onerror=|onload=|<svg|%3csvg|<iframe|%3ciframe|%2e%2e|%252e|%00|%2500)/ or request_uri like "sleep(" or request_uri like "benchmark(" or request_uri like "../" or request_uri like "..%2f" or request_uri like "..%2F"), "T1190", if(request_uri like /(?i)(%3bcat|%3bls|%3bwhoami|%3bwget|%3bcurl|;cat|;ls|;whoami|;wget|;curl)/, "T1059", if((((path like "upload" or path = "/api/Complaints") and (method = "POST" or method = "PUT")) or path like "shell.php" or path like "cmd.php" or path like "c99.php" or path like "r57.php" or path like "b374k" or path like "wso.php" or path like "webshell"), "T1505_003", if((path like ".env" or path like ".git" or path like ".kdbx" or path like ".htpasswd" or path like "/.aws" or path like "/.ssh" or path like "id_rsa"), "T1552_001", if((path like ".bak" or path like ".sql" or path like ".old" or path like ".zip" or path like ".tar" or path like ".gz" or path like ".dump" or path like ".backup"), "T1213", if((path like "/ftp" or path like "/encryptionkeys" or path like "/support/logs" or path like "/juice-shop" or path like "node_modules" or path like "package.json" or path like "package-lock.json" or (status = 301 and path like "/assets")), "T1083", if((path like "phpinfo" or path like "/server-info" or path like "/actuator/env" or path like "/actuator/heapdump" or path like "/proc/self" or path like "/etc/passwd" or path like "/etc/shadow" or path like "/WEB-INF"), "T1082", if((method = "POST" and path = "/api/Users"), "T1136", if((path like "/api/Users" or path like "/rest/admin" or path like "/rest/user/authentication-details"), "T1087", if((method = "CONNECT" or request_uri like /^https?:/), "T1090", if(request_uri like /(?i)(=https?:|=https?%3a|=ftp:)/, "T1105", if((status = 200 and bytes_sent > 5000000), "T1041", if(request_uri like "%25", "T1027", if((user_agent like /(?i)(nikto|nuclei|sqlmap|acunetix|nessus|openvas|zaproxy|wpscan)/ or path like "/wp-login.php" or path like "/wp-admin" or path like "/xmlrpc.php" or path like "/phpmyadmin" or path like "/actuator" or path like "/cgi-bin" or path like "/boaform" or path like "/phpunit" or path like "/HNAP1" or path like "/manager/html" or path like "/solr" or path like "/jenkins" or path like "/server-status" or path like "/.DS_Store" or path like "/config.json"), "T1595_002", if(user_agent like /(?i)(gobuster|dirbuster|ffuf|wfuzz|feroxbuster|dirb)/, "T1595_003", if(status = 404, "T1595", "none")))))))))))))))))) as t0
| fields (t0 = "T1041") as hit
| stats sum(hit) as cnt

panels.title: 유출

panels.description: T1499.002 서비스 고갈 플러드 = NGINX 로그에서 한 IP가 1분에 300건을 넘게 요청한 (IP × 분) 구간 수. T1496 리소스 하이재킹 = 웹 ASG CPU 최대값이 90% 이상인 5분 구간 수. T1498 네트워크 플러드 = 웹 ASG 수신 패킷 5분 합계가 30만 이상인 5분 구간 수. 임계값은 평소 트래픽에 맞게 수식의 숫자를 조정하세요.

targets.expression:
stats count(*) as req by ip, bin(1m)
| fields (req > 300) as breach
| stats sum(breach) as cnt
